description: Edit the Git staging area directly, as the Eclipse EGit Staging view lets you: Working Tree ↔ Index and Base ↔ Index editors whose Index side is a real, saveable editor, a Staging view, and a commit area with amend, sign-off, author and committer.
capabilities.untrusted: Runs Git, which can execute repository hooks and configured filters.
welcome.noRepository: No Git repository is open. Open a folder that contains one, or use the Source Control view to initialize or clone a repository.
command.switchDiff: Switch Between Working Tree and Base Diff
command.toggleStagedBase: Switch Base Between HEAD and Upstream
command.discardChange: Discard Hunk or Selected Lines from Working Tree
config.stagedCompareBase: What the Index of a staged file is compared with when it opens from the Staging view.
config.stagedCompareBase.head: The last commit (HEAD), as in EGit. The gutter arrow unstages a block.
config.stagedCompareBase.upstream: The upstream branch of the current branch (for example origin/main). Falls back to HEAD when there is none.
config.presentation: How the Staging view lists files.
config.presentation.list: A flat list, with the folder next to each file name.
config.presentation.compactTree: A folder tree in which folders with a single subfolder are joined.
config.sortBy: The order of files in the Staging view.
config.sortBy.name: By path.
config.sortBy.status: By kind of change, then by path.
config.showUntracked: Show untracked files in the Unstaged Changes list.
config.followActiveEditor: Show the repository of the active editor in the Staging view (EGit's Link with Editor).
config.signOffByDefault: Check Sign-off in the commit area by default.
config.problemCheck: Check the staged files for problems (errors and warnings in the Problems view) before committing.
config.problemCheck.warn: Ask before committing files that have problems.
config.problemCheck.block: Refuse to commit files that have problems.
config.problemSeverity: The least severe problem that counts for indexEditor.commit.problemCheck.
config.messageHistorySize: How many earlier commit messages, authors and committers are remembered.
config.assumeUnchanged: Mark files flagged assume-unchanged with "AU" in the Explorer.
